prompt.project_info: Create a high-resolution 9:16 black-and-white portrait of one approved adult woman in a minimalist studio with geometric cross-beam light.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with black hair in a neat Korean-style low bun, calm introspective slightly distant expression, small gold earrings, natural skin texture, and a sharp black ribbed turtleneck.
composition_elements: Subject stands slightly to the side in a vertical portrait with soft background falloff.
Bold geometric window-like light and shadow shapes cross the face, body, and dark studio background.
Keep side profile, bun, turtleneck ribbing, earrings, and high-contrast facial detail clear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic side studio lighting with strong cross-beams and geometric shadows, one side of the face illuminated and the other in deep shadow, restrained cinematic monochrome tone.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 9:16 portrait, 85mm lens at f/4, 8K detail, sharp face and suit texture, soft background blur, fine monochrome grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-resolution black-and-white portrait of one approved adult woman with black hair in a neat low bun, small gold earrings, calm introspective slightly distant expression, and a sharp black ribbed turtleneck. She stands slightly to the side in a minimalist studio as dramatic cross-beams of light create bold geometric shadows on her face and the background. Use cinematic high contrast, fine facial and fabric detail, soft background falloff, 85mm lens, 9:16 framing, 8K photorealism, no text, no watermark.
